errors.text_span: erreicht im Dezember 2024 einen Tiefpunkt von etwa –3,5 Euro/MWh
errors.evidence: The description states that a low point of approximately -3.5 Euro/MWh is reached in December 2024. However, the graph shows this low point occurs in November 2024. In December 2024, the value fluctuates between approximately -1 and -3 Euro/MWh.

errors.text_span: bleibt jedoch unter dem Niveau von –5 Euro/MWh
errors.evidence: The description claims that in February 2025 the value remains below -5 Euro/MWh. The graph clearly shows the line rising in February 2025, with the final data point being approximately -2 Euro/MWh, which is well above -5 Euro/MWh.
